The new tuple-index handling in `_as_dynamic` is unconditional: a DataArray with tuple-valued snapshot labels now has those labels converted into a MultiIndex using the network’s snapshot level names before building the frame. The base implementation did not do that conversion, so such an input can produce a differently indexed dynamic frame even under legacy semantics with the default, `"auto"`, or `"multiindex"` option.
